title: Petri V2 DotCap
description:
This is a replacement chuff cap for the DotMod Petri V2 RDA, offering better airflow with a wider drip tip while maintaining a heat resistant base to ensure you will have a smooth experience even with your angriest builds.

- Two-piece chuff style design for maximum draw

- Heat resistant Delrin base

- Frosty acrylic tip

- Fits Petri V1, V1.5, V2 (not compatible with dotRDA24/Standard Tank/RTA/RDTA)
